task.title: ENGINE box says 'will not lift' on a vessel already in orbit
task.body:
## What the player sees

With the new default start (\`Apollo TLI-1\`, 126.9 t on the S-IVB's 1023 kN, slice F of ADR 0053, #646), every new game opens with the ENGINE box reading \`TWR 0.82 (max 0.82, will not lift)\` in red while the vessel is in orbit. Nothing needs to lift; the warning reads as if something is wrong with the start vessel.

## Why

\`engineTWRCell\` (\`internal/tui/screens/orbit_box_engine.go\`) computes TWR against the primary's surface gravity and shows "will not lift" whenever max TWR < 1.0, wherever the vessel is (ADR 0051 decision 13b). Pre-existing for any low-TWR vessel in orbit; the new default start just makes it the first thing a new player sees.

## To triage

TWR < 1 still matters near a surface (a descent that can't be stopped), so "only when Landed" may be too narrow. Options: say it only when Landed or below some altitude, or reword in orbit (e.g. a neutral TWR without the verdict). Decision 13b of ADR 0051 owns this row.
